About: 'Forget business casual, we're princess casual!'; started as the username of 'a girl who loved sweet motifs'; 'she started out sewing everything on her own'; 'we have outsourced small batches of clothing in China, California, and New York'; 'against sweat shops of any kind'; 'proud to be independent and black woman owned'. (pages/about-us)
Homepage banner: 'Free shipping on orders over $200'. Homepage description: 'a romantic boutique made for dreamers'.

Refund policy: 14 days after receiving the item to request a return, unworn with tags; buyer pays return shipping; no returns on items 20% or more off, custom or made-to-order items. (pages/refund-policy)
Shipping policy: in-stock items ship within 2-5 business days; handmade-to-order items within 3-6 weeks; preorders in 1-2 months.
Sizing standard: XS (bust 30-32in) to 5XL (bust 55-57in, high waist 50-52in). Most dresses offered XS-5XL; sweatshirt dresses stop at 3XL.
